items.question: Within what vast multitude of womb-diagrams are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The count specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings within these locations are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across an immense array of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The specific subjects who are tormented are not explicitly named in this verse and must be inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
